record.field: Fever, sore throat, mild body ache and runny nose for 3 days.
Acute Viral Fever with Upper Respiratory Tract Infection (URTI)

• Complete bed rest for 3-5 days. • Drink plenty of lukewarm water, ORS, and clear soups. • Warm saline gargle 3 times daily. • Report immediately if fever exceeds 103°F or breathing difficulty occurs.

record.field: Epigastric burning pain, bloating, and heartburn after meals.
• Avoid spicy, oily, fried foods, coffee, and carbonated drinks. • Eat small, frequent meals on time. • Do not lie down within 2 hours after dinner.

record.field: Occasional occipital headache, dizziness, elevated blood pressure readings.
• Strictly restrict table salt and processed foods (DASH diet). • Brisk walking for 30 minutes at least 5 days a week. • Maintain a home Blood Pressure log twice daily.
